summary: Frontend-only bug-fix verification for the Livepeer HLS iframe player swap. Tested /channel/testdj offline+live, /dashboard offline+live, sibling components, and the SessionList inline VOD wiring. All targeted assertions passed. DB was flipped to is_live:true for live-state tests and reset to false afterward.

channel_live.iframe_covers_video_shell: true (iframe box 918x515.5 inside 920x517.5 shell — 1px border on each side, expected)

sessions_vod.note: No VOD entries exist for testdj, so runtime click-through could not be executed. Code inspection of SessionList.jsx confirms it renders <HlsPlayer playbackId={selected.playback_id} isLive={true} muted={false} autoPlay /> — the resulting iframe src will start with https://lvpr.tv/?v=... per HlsPlayer logic. Recommend seeding one session for future automated coverage.

console_errors_observed: The lvpr.tv iframe internally logs manifestParsingError + 'Stream open failed' because no RTMP is actually being pushed to the Livepeer playback_id. These originate from Livepeer's player, not our app, and are expected in a synthetic 'is_live=true in DB but no real broadcast' test scenario.
critical_code_review_comments: HlsPlayer.jsx correctly guards offline state (!playbackId || !isLive) and builds src via URLSearchParams — safe against injection.

SessionList passes isLive={true} to HlsPlayer for VODs which is a slight semantic mismatch (VOD isn't 'live') but functionally correct since the guard only checks isLive to differentiate from offline poster. Consider renaming the prop to 'ready' or adding a separate 'mode' prop for clarity.

Dashboard.jsx lines 184-188 have redundant ternary — both branches call HlsPlayer with the same playbackId, differing only by isLive. Could be simplified to <HlsPlayer playbackId={channel.playback_id} isLive={channel.is_live} />.

iframe allow attribute triggers a browser warning 'Allow attribute will take precedence over allowfullscreen' — harmless but the allowFullScreen prop is now redundant since 'fullscreen' is included in allow. Optional cleanup.
seed_data_creation: None. Flipped channels.is_live to true and reset to false via mongosh as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HlsPlayer swap to lvpr.tv iframe is verified working. DB state for testdj is is_live:false (reset). If future VOD testing is needed, seed a sessions row for testdj with a valid playback_id. Backend was intentionally not retested; iteration_3 report covers it.
rca of the issue: Previous native <video> tag could not play HLS in non-Safari browsers without hls.js, resulting in an unresponsive/unclickable player. The fix delegates playback to Livepeer's hosted iframe (lvpr.tv) which handles HLS decoding, autoplay policy, and browser compatibility. Offline state now short-circuits to a poster instead of an empty <video>, eliminating the 'unclickable container' UX. Verified: iframe is the top element at its center point, i.e., no CSS overlay steals pointer events.
